verdict: Real merger into Morgan Stanley (28.25 USD + 0.5833 MS per share, closed 2021-03-01); library is right except the missing USD currency and an assumed-par fill after a stale-close gate failure.

verification.notes: The 8-K filed 2021-03-01 (Items 2.01 and 3.01) confirms the report. Mixed Consideration is 0.5833 MS plus $28.25 cash, and holders who made no election were paid it. Closing was 2021-03-01, and the NYSE was asked to suspend trading on that date, so the last trade was 2021-02-26. The library's numbers match. Only the blank cash_currency is wrong, and the filing's XBRL tag iso4217:USD supports USD. I did not check any market price.
